title: 🧵 How to Use the Industrial Digitizer

steps.title: Upload Artwork or Open Embroidery Files 📁
steps.description: Upload any artwork (SVG, PNG, JPG, WEBP) or open pre-existing embroidery machine files (.DST, .PES, .EXP, .JEF, .VP3, .XXX, .SEW). The engine automatically detects vectors or applies color segmentation, displaying stitch geometries instantly.

steps.title: Choose Engine & Stitch Geometry 🎛️
steps.description: Preview realistic thread textures, lighting shadows, and jump-stitch dashed vectors. Use the bottom floating toolbar to play, pause, step forward/backward stitch-by-stitch, or scrub playback speed from 1x up to 100x. Use mouse wheel or pinch gestures to zoom and pan the embroidery hoop.

steps.title: Direct Stitch & File Inspection 🔍
steps.description: Click the Inspect button on the canvas toolbar to open the full-screen virtual inspection stream. Powered by Angular CDK Virtual Scroll, easily scroll through 10,000+ stitch instructions at 60 FPS, filter by Stitches, Jumps, or Color Changes, jump directly to specific stitch indices, and copy technical specifications.

steps.title: Machine Health & Quality Audit 🩺
steps.description: Click Audit Quality to run a real-time pre-flight diagnostic scan. The engine inspects your design for needle-breakage micro-stitches (<0.5 mm), snagging long stitches (>12.7 mm), density hotspots, and missing tie-in / tie-off lock stitches, giving you an overall Machine Readiness Score and safety tips.

steps.title: Multi-Format Industrial Export 💾
steps.description: Download your ready-to-sew files in any major commercial embroidery format: Tajima (.DST), Brother (.PES), Melco/Bernina (.EXP), Janome (.JEF), Husqvarna Viking (.VP3), Singer (.XXX), or .SEW, or export high-resolution PNG/SVG mockups for production sheets.

cards.title: Rust & WebAssembly Computational Geometry 🦀
cards.description: A high-performance Rust core compiled to WebAssembly (WASM) performs polygon raycasting, scanline slicing, contour normal offsetting, and path planning. It executes complex multi-layer stitch calculations across millions of operations in sub-millisecond execution times.

cards.title: Clipper2 Boolean Overlap Removal ✂️
cards.description: Using the industrial-grade Clipper2 polygon clipping library in Rust, the digitizer performs boolean difference operations between layered shapes. Underneath layers are automatically trimmed to eliminate double-density bulletproof fabric stiffness and save thread.

cards.title: Euler Path & TSP Travel Optimization 🧭
cards.description: The pipeline optimizes stitch sequencing using Traveling Salesperson heuristics and shortest-path graph algorithms. Disjoint regions are stitched efficiently with minimized jump distances, automatically inserting 3-stitch tie-in and tie-off lock stitches to guarantee stitch durability.

cards.title: Multi-Format Binary Encoders & Decoders 🧬
cards.description: Custom binary encoders transpile coordinate streams into multi-vendor bitwise formats (.DST, .PES, .EXP, .JEF, .VP3, .XXX, .SEW) with byte-level header checksums, coordinate compression, and color palette blocks directly in memory.

cards.title: 60 FPS Micro-DOM Virtual Scrolling ⚡
cards.description: The Direct Stitch Inspection table utilizes Angular CDK Virtual Scroll (cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport). Even with 10,000+ stitch coordinate objects, only ~30 active DOM rows are rendered at any given moment, maintaining silky-smooth 60 FPS scrolling with negligible memory overhead.

cards.title: Web Worker Multithreading 🧵
cards.description: Heavy WASM geometry generation runs in an isolated background Web Worker thread, keeping the Angular 19 UI completely responsive and stutter-free during complex embroidery processing.
